name: git-ops
description: Swappable SCM + issue-tracker adapter for the dev-cycle. Exposes one entrypoint — `git-ops on <event> --json '<payload>'` — that projects pipeline lifecycle events onto a project tracker + branch/commit/PR conventions. Ships a config-driven GitHub provider (Issues + ProjectV2 + gh SCM). Author alternate providers (gitlab/linear/jira) implementing the same events.
